mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_bills( `date`, `company_id`, branch_id, location_id, exchange_rate, vendor_id, deposit_to, account_codes, account_description, reference, cheque_number, bank_number, note, created, created_by, is_approved, is_active ) VALUES ( #{payBills.date}, #{payBills.companyId}, #{payBills.branchId}, #{payBills.locationId}, #{payBills.exchangeRate}, #{payBills.vendorId}, #{payBills.depositTo}, #{payBills.accountCode}, #{payBills.accountDescription}, #{payBills.reference}, #{payBills.chequeNumber}, #{payBills.bankNo}, #{payBills.note}, NOW(), #{payBills.createdBy}, 1, #{payBills.isActive} );

mapper.sql: pay_bills.id AS id, pay_bills.date AS date, pay_bills.id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, pay_bills.reference AS reference, CASE WHEN (pay_bills.type_id = 1) THEN (SELECT SUM(credit) FROM general_ledger_details WHERE general_ledger_id = pay_bills.gl_id) ELSE (SELECT SUM(paid) FROM pay_bill_details WHERE pay_bill_id = pay_bills.id) END AS totalAmount, COALESCE((SELECT name FROM vendors WHERE id = pay_bills.vendor_id), '') AS venderName, (SELECT CONCAT(account_codes, '-',account_description) FROM chart_accounts WHERE id = pay_bills.deposit_to) AS chartAccountName, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(paid) FROM pay_bill_details WHERE pay_bill_id = pay_bills.id), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(pay_bills.note, '') AS note, pay_bills.gl_id AS glId, IFNULL(pay_bills.exchange_rate, 0) AS exchangeRate, pay_bills.cheque_number AS chequeNumber, (SELECT name FROM companies WHERE id = pay_bills.company_id) AS `companyName`, pay_bills.account_codes AS accountCode, pay_bills.type_id AS `type`
FROM pay_bills LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = pay_bills.branch_id

WHERE pay_bills.is_active = 1
AND (pay_bills.reference LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.reference}, "%"))
AND pay_bills.vendor_id = #{filter.vendorId}
AND DATE(pay_bills.date) >= DATE(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND DATE(pay_bills.date) <= DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT pr_code FROM purchase_requests WHERE id = po.purchase_request_id LIMIT 01) IS NULL THEN '' ELSE COALESCE(po.po_code, '') END AS poCode, CASE WHEN (pbd.purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL) THEN COALESCE( (SELECT pr_code FROM purchase_requests WHERE id = po.purchase_request_id LIMIT 1), po.po_code, '' ) ELSE general_ledgers.reference END AS invoiceCode, IFNULL(pbd.paid, 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(pbd.description, '') AS description FROM pay_bill_details AS pbd LEFT JOIN purchase_orders AS po ON pbd.purchase_order_id = po.id LEFT JOIN general_ledger_details ON general_ledger_details.id = pbd.general_ledger_detail_id LEFT JOIN general_ledgers ON general_ledgers.id = general_ledger_details.general_ledger_id WHERE pbd.pay_bill_id = #{payBillId}

SELECT '' AS poCode, '' AS invoiceCode, IFNULL(gld.debit, 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(gld.memo, '') AS description, '' AS reference FROM general_ledger_details AS gld WHERE debit > 0 AND gld.general_ledger_id = #{glId}
